name: Estelle
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, this one-of-a-kind wig features a rooted beige-blonde balayage with buttery blonde ends. A deep brunette shadow root blends into sandy beige mid-lengths with fine blonde highlights. A thin ribbon of pale blonde brightens the hairline, and the color gradually warms toward the ends. 

All photos are taken in natural lighting.

You can care for and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled. If the style shifts during shipping, you can give her a light touch-up after unboxing.

All sales are final.
features: Added Band / removable silicone padding/ 3 combs / adjustable drawstring
